title: Priest tells Vallee to burn an IBM circuit card as 'from the Devil'

tellings.quote: and he looked at it and he said my son burn it it is from the Devil

plain: A Catholic priest in France once looked at a circuit card from an IBM computer and told the person showing it, "My son, burn it, it is from the Devil," according to Jacques Vallée, a computer scientist and longtime UFO researcher who was there for the story in the 1950s or 60s and links it to someone he calls Michelle. Vallée tells it to show how new technology can look like something evil or otherworldly to people who are not ready for it.
